description: Defines a template class 'flat_map' in the 'base::internal' namespace, implementing a map-like container using a sorted vector, inheriting from 'flat_tree'. Includes constructors, assignment operators, insert, access, and swap methods, with detailed comments and documentation.

classes.name: flat_map
